name: engram
description: pi-durable project-brain kernel: durable local-model agent core with approval gates, subagents, and a token-auth HTTP/SSE API. Runs standalone as a single project brain (executable mode) or composes into apps via createCoreInstance() (kernel mode).

scripts.test: echo "app/: test tiers live in the repo root — 'npm run test:unit' is the hermetic suite CI runs; 'npm run test:live:model|sandbox|webui' need a live model (see docs/testing.md)" && npm run test:unit --prefix ..
